_readme: Anchor points on each passing master hand image (hands v2, 25 Sept 2026), used by build/skin_hands.py to place jewellery and by the game to animate it. Coordinates are pixels in the master image (size given). angle_deg: the direction the hand, arm or finger points, 0 = up the frame, positive = clockwise. Each hand: side (right/left; single-hand images are right hands, the game mirrors them for the left); wrist {x, y, angle_deg, width_px, source auto|manual}: the measured wrist of the arm (hand_masks.find_wrists), also used to clip the sleeve; landmarks {points: 21 [x, y] MediaPipe hand joints, score, runs, source}: from build/hand_landmarks.py; ring {mcp, pip (the ring finger's base knuckle and middle joint, landmarks 13 and 14), x, y (the ring's centre: 35% from MCP to PIP, and at least just past the web), angle_deg, width_px (finger width measured across the segment), view back|palm|side|hidden (back: band and stone; palm/side: thin band; hidden: not drawn), facing, curl_deg, web_t, source mediapipe|manual (joints marked by eye), view_source manual (view pinned by eye), note}; bracelet {x, y, angle_deg, width_px, width_from}: where wrist jewellery (tennis bracelet, bangles) centres, at the wrist joint across the forearm. Manual joints and views live in build/hand_ring_pins.py and are applied on every run. Checked on build/contact-sheets/hands-rings-debug-*.png and hands-<character>-rings-*.png. Jewellery sprites are drawn for a wrist 200 px wide and a finger 54 px wide.
